articles.title: Height curbs locking up space in core Bengaluru, Shivakumar tells Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Karnataka Deputy CM DK Shivakumar met Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, urging a review of height restrictions imposed by Bengaluru's defence airports. These limitations significantly impact urban construction and development in the city. The interaction sought a balanced solution, enabling essential city growth while ensuring defence operational security, highlighting the need for inter-ministerial coordination on critical infrastructure policies.

articles.title: Global Additive Manufacturing in Defense Market Projected to Hit USD 24.81 Billion by 2035 – SNS Insider
articles.summary: A recent report by SNS Insider highlights the significant growth of Additive Manufacturing (3D printing) in the global defense market. Valued at USD 5.01 Billion in 2025, this sector is projected for substantial expansion. The technology offers defense industries innovative solutions for rapid prototyping, specialized part production, and supply chain resilience, indicating its increasing strategic importance for military applications worldwide.

articles.title: Scientists Say They’ve Figured Out What That Golden Orb Found at the Bottom of the Pacific Ocean Actually Was
articles.summary: Scientists have finally identified a mysterious "golden orb" discovered at the bottom of the ocean, after two and a half years of intensive study. This groundbreaking identification marks a significant innovation from the bleeding edge of science and technology. The discovery underscores the ongoing efforts in deep-sea exploration and the complex biological mysteries still awaiting solutions in marine environments, showcasing the perseverance of scientific inquiry.

articles.title: The legacy of 'Eagle Claw': How failure helped build America's elite special forces
articles.summary: Forty-six years ago, in April 1980, the U.S. military faced a significant setback during Operation Eagle Claw. This Delta Force mission was a complex attempt to rescue American hostages held in Tehran, Iran. Conducted in the challenging Iranian desert, the multi-asset operation tragically ended in disaster, offering profound lessons for future special operations planning.

articles.title: Manitoba municipalities call for RCMP contract changes as policing costs grow
articles.summary: Manitoba municipalities and the Royal Canadian Mounted Police (RCMP) are preparing for critical contract negotiations. Community leaders are pressing for solutions to address escalating policing costs while ensuring public safety standards are not compromised. The talks will also involve federal cost-sharing, highlighting the financial strain on smaller communities to maintain essential police services across Manitoba.
